fields.Name: CRD-05 - Isolation
fields.Description: Verify the organization boundary: staff read and write only the programs of organizations they are a member of, another organization's IDs are refused exactly like random ones, users holding only UI, only Credentialing Applicant or staff without a membership read nothing, the administrator reads every organization and no program, and every permission row carries the row filter the permission model requires.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All nine cred-isolation checks pass against the world's two organizations; the sample program and Program B are left unchanged.
